page.overview:
What is Unidentified Force technique?

In 228 BBY, a Force technique was being studied by Jedi Master Elzar Mann, who considered the technique to be esoteric and near-forgotten. At the end of the day, Mann spent the night in bed with his lover and fellow Jedi Master Avar Kriss in Kriss' quarters on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. After waking up the following morning and reaching for his datapad, Mann mentally recalled his research into the Force technique.

The Force technique was mentioned in the 2025 novel The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi, written by Charles Soule as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's
